channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: 2026 USTA October Level 4 Open (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Sat 10/3 – Mon 10/5 · times not yet published | Mobile Tennis Center | No published price. A USTA Level 4 open draws roughly 200 players from around the country to the Mobile Tennis Center over three days. Match times and any spectator admission are not published on the host page, and the host's own address for the venue misspells the street name that USTA's own venue contact page corrects to Gaillard Drive.

item.title: 20th Anniversary Event: 20 Years of Stories (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 | Pace Library | No published price. Pace Library marks its 20th anniversary with a celebration called 20 Years of Stories, anchored by a Friends of the Pace Library book sale alongside crafts and family activities. The celebration runs October 3.

item.title: Bahia Grass Invitational Lawnmower Racing and Fish Fry (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM · heats 9 AM to 11 AM and 2 PM until dark | Santa Rosa County Fairgrounds | No published price. The Santa Rosa County Fair Association hosts its first lawnmower racing day at the county fairgrounds in Milton, with souped up mowers running under Nasgrass rules. Heats run from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM and again from 2:00 PM until dark, with fried fish dinners for sale between races. Proceeds go to the Milton Rotary Club, Santa Rosa Kids House and the Fair Association, and the Santa Rosa County Extension Service adds lawn care and water quality tips.

item.title: Ballet Pensacola: Frankenstein (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Fri 10/2 7 PM · Sat 10/3 1:30 PM and 7 PM · Sun 10/4 1:30 PM | Ballet Pensacola, The Center | No published price. A gothic, atmospheric Frankenstein ballet plays one October weekend, October 2-4, a moody, elegant date. Bonus for a young dance fan: a matinee could work too.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Thursday 10/1 | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: HUNKS THE SHOW at Wind Creek Atmore (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Fri 10/2 · 8:00 PM and Sat 10/3 · 7:00 PM | Coosawada Ballroom, Wind Creek Atmore | No published price. HUNKS THE SHOW plays the Coosawada Ballroom at Wind Creek Atmore, Friday at 8 PM and Saturday at 7 PM. Wind Creek bills it as adult-oriented programming, but no age minimum is published, so confirm before buying tickets.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Tuesday 9/15 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. No viewing hours are published for Tuesday, September 15, so call the library to confirm.

item.title: Karaoke & DJ Nights: FUBAR Pizza Bar (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Nightly · 9 PM-1 AM | FUBAR Pizza Bar | Free. Late-night karaoke runs five nights a week (Sun, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat) plus a DJ on Monday and Thursday, 9 PM to 1 AM every night, with pizza till close. It is in Fort Walton Beach.

item.title: Karaoke Block: The Block (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Wed-Sat · from 6 PM (Thu 8 PM) | The Block | Free. The Sports & Karaoke room at The Block runs Wednesday through Saturday, opening at 6 (8 on Thursday) and going late. It is downtown Fort Walton Beach.

item.title: Live Music: Manci's Antique Club (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Thu 6:30 PM · Fri-Sat 7:30 PM · Sun 6:00 PM | Manci's Antique Club | Free. This Daphne institution has walls of Jim Beam decanters and live local bands Thursday through Sunday. It is a grown-up night out.

item.title: Live Music: Paradise Bar & Grill (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Tue/Fri/Sat 5:30 PM · Sun 2:30 PM | Paradise Bar & Grill | Free. Beachside live music plays most nights on Pensacola Beach, with rotating local acts starting at 5:30 (Sundays 2:30). Wine Down Wednesday runs $3 house and $6 premium wines all day.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM · opening reception Thursday 10/8 · 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free, and the opening reception on October 8 runs from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

item.title: Mike Goodwin at the Crescent Theater (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 4:00 PM (doors 3:00 PM) · 7:00 PM show sold out | Crescent Theater | No published price. Comedian Mike Goodwin plays two sets at the Crescent Theater in downtown Mobile, and the 7 PM show is already sold out, leaving the 4 PM early show. Goodwin is a South Carolina native and Army veteran known for his bow tie and for comedy without a foul or vulgar word. He has appeared on America's Got Talent and Dry Bar Comedy. The theater lists both shows as 18 and up.

item.title: Northwest Florida Fair (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Tue 9/29 – Sat 10/3 · gates 5 PM weekdays, 2 PM Saturday · building/midway close times vary by day (see steps) | Destin-FWB Rigdon Center | from $10. The Northwest Florida Fair returns to the Destin-FWB Rigdon Center for five days, with separate hours for the exhibit buildings and the midway rides. It is an educational and entertainment event serving Okaloosa, South Walton and Santa Rosa counties. Ride armbands are sold separately from gate admission, and the price steps up on Friday and Saturday.

item.title: Nuts and Butts Festival (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Friday 10/2 through Sunday 10/4 · all day | Coastal County Brewing Company | No published price. Coastal County's pork and peanut festival runs three days in the beer garden. It is all day Friday through Sunday on the brewery's own calendar. No admission is published.

item.title: Ocean Hour Beach Cleanup (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturdays · start time and site posted each week | Rotating, Pensacola Beach / area waterfronts | Free. Give an hour and leave the beach better. Buckets, grabbers, and gloves are provided. It is a service morning that fits the family's values and is kid-friendly.

item.title: Pensacola Beach Songwriters Festival (cherry-pick sets) (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Oct 1-11 · venue-by-venue schedule | 22+ venues, Pensacola Beach + downtown | Free. Ten days of acoustic storyteller rounds run, mostly free, a build-your-own date. Many venues are bars; the cleaner picks are the daytime Gulfside Pavilion sets and restaurant listening rooms (Native Café, Flounders dinner sets).

item.title: Pensacola Symphony: Opening Night Dress Rehearsal (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · Doors 1:00 PM · Rehearsal 1:30 PM | Pensacola Saenger Theatre | from $10. Watch the Pensacola Symphony work through its Opening Night program at a public dress rehearsal, Dvorak's Carnival Overture through Ravel's Daphnis et Chloe, Suite No. 2. General admission is $10 at the door, by phone, or online, well under that evening's ticketed concert. Expect stops and starts as the orchestra polishes each piece.

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: Punchis Punchis Banda Rave (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Sat 10/3 · 10:00 PM (doors 9:00 PM) | Vinyl Music Hall | No published price. Vinyl Music Hall turns over its main room to a late-night electronic and banda rave, with doors at 9 PM ahead of a 10 PM start. It is a standing, general-admission show on downtown Palafox Street, close to other bars and parking if the night runs long.

item.title: South Alabama Comic Con (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM · Sunday 10/4 · 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Mobile Convention Center | from $30. South Alabama Comic Con fills the Mobile Convention Center for two days with guests from film, television, anime and comics, plus cosplay, artist and vendor booths, and gaming. The show includes a costume contest, guest Q&As and fan panels. Children ten and under get in free with a paid adult, limited to two children per adult ticket. Autographs and photo ops cost extra, and every bag is searched at the door.

item.title: Take a Kid Fishing (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 8:30 AM or 9:30 AM time slots | Navarre Beach Fishing Pier | from $10. The event's own dedicated site has kids sign up for an 8:30 or 9:30 AM slot at the pier, where the first 200 registered children receive a free fishing pole and bag with their ten-dollar registration. It is built specifically for children and their families, right alongside the Navarre Fishing Rodeo the same weekend.

item.title: Teen Dungeons and Dragons at Moorer (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturdays 11:30 AM to 1:30 PM · Tuesdays 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. The Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library runs a tabletop Dungeons & Dragons adventure for teens ages 12 to 18. Registration is recommended, and upcoming sessions include Tuesday, October 6, Saturday, October 17, and Tuesday, October 20.

item.title: The Ultimate Garth Brooks Tribute featuring Shawn Gerard (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 7:30 PM (doors 6:30 PM) | OWA Theater | No published price. Shawn Gerard brings a Garth Brooks tribute to the OWA Theater in Foley, singing the country hits with a full band and a high-energy production. Gerard is based in Nashville and previously performed in residence at Legends in Concert in Las Vegas. OWA's page does not print a ticket price, so check the ticket link before you go.

item.title: Tormented Trolley Tours (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 6:30 PM, 7:30 PM and 8:30 PM | Historic Pensacola Village | from $15. Historic Pensacola kicks off its haunted season with trolley tours that tell the ghost stories of North Hill after dark. Tours run at 6:30 PM, 7:30 PM and 8:30 PM, and children 3 and older are welcome. Each session is limited to 28 people, and guests stay on the trolley for the whole tour.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Weekend Live Music: Sandshaker Lounge (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Every weekend · evenings | Sandshaker Lounge | Free. The Shaker, birthplace of the Bushwacker, has live music every weekend and never a cover. It is a classic Pensacola Beach dive, about 25 minutes from the bridge.

item.title: Flora-Bama Paddle Dash (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 7:00 AM | Flora-Bama Ole River Grill | No published price. A family-friendly paddleboard race runs 2 miles from Flora-Bama's Ole River Grill up to the Ono Island Bridge and back, with a grab-and-go breakfast for participants after. The first 100 registered racers get a free T-shirt, and the top three men and women win a Flora-Bama gift card. Spectating from the Ole River Grill dock is free; the entry fee for racers is not published on the organizer's pages.

item.title: Parkrun: Free Timed 5K (Rec Plex North) (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturdays · 7:30 AM | UWF Rec Plex North Field | Free. A free, timed, all-comers 5K runs every Saturday. Walk, run, or push the jogging stroller. The kids can earn official times too, with one-time free barcode registration.

item.title: City of Destin Community Yard Sale (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM | Destin Community Center | No published price. The Destin Community Center turns its parking lot into a community yard sale on Saturday morning, weather permitting. Each seller's reserved space comes with one city table and two chairs, and sellers may bring a second table from home. Shoppers who come early get the first look, since sellers set up from 7:00 AM.

item.title: Pensacola State College Day of Clays (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM | Santa Rosa Shooting Center | No published price. Santa Rosa Shooting Center sets aside the day for Pensacola State College Day of Clays. Call the range closer to the date to register.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: WEAR TV 3 Shred-a-Thon (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Pensacola Interstate Fair parking lot | No published price. WEAR TV 3 runs a document shredding event in the Pensacola Interstate Fair's parking lot, letting residents drop off paperwork for secure destruction.

item.title: Ocean Hour: Bob Sikes South Beach Cleanup (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 8:45 AM | Ocean Hour, Bob Sikes Fishing Pier | Free. Ocean Hour's weekly volunteer cleanup meets at the Bob Sikes Fishing Pier parking lot next to the Grand Marlin Restaurant for a stretch of Pensacola Beach south of the bridge. The group provides all supplies, so families just need closed-toe shoes, water and sunscreen for about an hour of picking up litter. Weather cancellations are posted to Ocean Hour's Facebook page.

item.title: 18th Annual Day of Clays Tournament (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 9:00 AM | Santa Rosa Shooting Center | from $250. The 18th Annual Day of Clays Tournament brings a clay shoot fundraiser to the Santa Rosa Shooting Center, supporting scholarships and programs at Pensacola State College. A single shooter registers for $250, with separate sponsorship and team tiers for groups. Registration opens at 7:30 AM and the shotgun start goes off at 9 AM on October 3.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Oct 31 · 9 AM to 6 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | No published price. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's own page does not print admission prices, so check the ticket page before driving out.

item.title: Coastal Alabama Farmers & Fishermens Market (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturdays · 9 AM-2 PM | Coastal Alabama Market | Free. The county's largest market sells fresh Gulf seafood straight from the boats plus produce and makers. It is five minutes from OWA, so it stacks with a Tropic Falls day.

item.title: Dog Daze (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM | Fort Walton Beach Landing Park | Free. Friendship Veterinary Hospital presents a dog-friendly day at The Landing Park downtown, with contests, local rescue groups and vendor booths. Admission is free, so the cost of the day is whatever you spend at a vendor booth. Leashed dogs of every size are the point of the event, so this is not one for a family with a dog-reactive toddler.

item.title: Dog Daze, presented by Friendship Veterinary Hospital (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM CDT | The Landing Park | Free. Dog Daze, presented by Friendship Veterinary Hospital, runs at The Landing Park on Saturday, October 3, from 9 AM to 3 PM. It's free to attend.

item.title: Grand Boulevard Farmers' Market (SAT 10/3)
item.description: Saturdays · 9 AM-1 PM | Grand Park, Grand Boulevard at Sandestin | Free. A Saturday farmers and makers market fills the Sandestin green, with local honey, produce, and kettle corn. Pair it with a Destin/Baytowne day.
